instructions.task: Which intent does this customer message to a digital bank's support chat express? Pick the single most specific intent.
guidance: Distinguish the channel: card payment vs cash withdrawal (ATM) vs transfer vs top-up.
Distinguish the problem: pending, declined, failed, reverted, not recognised, fee charged, wrong exchange rate.
Messages often contain typos (e.g. 'pop-up' or 'topped off my car' for top-up); read for the intended meaning.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card they received; activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum/maximum age to open or use an account; can children/teens use it.

apple_pay_or_google_pay.meaning: Anything involving Apple Pay, Google Pay or phone wallets: adding the card, using them, top-ups via Apple/Google Pay not working.
examples: I got my American Express in Apple Pay, why is top up not working correctly?

criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, can I use the card at ATMs.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up: setting it up, how it works, turning it off.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.meaning: Money sent into this account by bank transfer (e.g. from their UK account) has not appeared yet / balance not updated; asks the usual time frame because a transfer they just made is not showing.
examples: How long does a transfer from the UK account usually take? After completing the transfer it is not showing up.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.meaning: Deposited a cheque or cash but the balance has not updated.
examples: the balance has not changed, but I have deposited some money

beneficiary_not_allowed.meaning: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, trouble transferring to a beneficiary, beneficiary not allowed, or a transfer to an account was not cleared/accepted.
examples: My account transfer was not cleared.
I am having trouble transferring money to a beneficiery.

cancel_transfer.meaning: Wants to cancel, revert or reverse a transfer/transaction they just made (e.g. sent to wrong account); not cancelling a purchase from a merchant.
examples: I want to revert this mornings transaction.

card_about_to_expire.meaning: Card is expiring / expired; getting a replacement card, including having it shipped to where they are abroad (e.g. China).
examples: Am I able to get this shipped to China?

criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; will shops/merchants accept it.

card_arrival.meaning: Ordered card is overdue / has not arrived after waiting; tracking a card that should already be here.
examples: Is my new bank card on the way and is there a way to track it?

card_delivery_estimate.meaning: When can I expect my card / how long card delivery takes (incl. to a given country); delivery time/options; express delivery.
examples: When can I expect my card? I live in the US.

card_linking.meaning: Linking/adding a card to the app or account; card they already have is not showing in the app.
examples: If my card was lost or stolen can I re-link it?

card_not_working.meaning: The card does not work / stopped working / something is wrong with the card in general, e.g. failed in several places (not specifically contactless, ATM, or virtual card).
examples: There is something wrong with my card. Tried to use it a few times today in different places and it just didn't work.

criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee on a card payment/purchase they made.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase on the account they do not recognise or did not make.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment in a foreign currency.
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM explicitly kept/swallowed/retained the card.

cash_withdrawal_charge.meaning: Charged a fee for withdrawing cash at an ATM; ATM fees; an unexpected fee when they thought it was free.
examples: Why did I get charged a fee, I thought it was free?

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.meaning: A cash withdrawal on the account they did not make; cash transactions showing in the app they do not recognise or did not receive.
examples: THere is some cash that is showing up on my app.
Please freeze my card. Someone has withdrawn money using my card in odd remote town. I have not done this withdrawal.

criteria.change_pin: How to change the card PIN to a new one (not finding it, not blocked).
criteria.compromised_card: Worried the card details were compromised/hacked/used by someone else; fraud on the card while they still have it.

country_support.meaning: Which countries the service/account/card is available in; can people outside the UK/in the EU/US get a card or account; using it abroad or moving country.
examples: Do you provide cards to people not in the UK?
Can the card be mailed to Europe?

declined_card_payment.meaning: A specific card payment was declined/rejected at a shop or online and they ask why.
examples: I could not get my card to work at a shop.

criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal declined/refused; could not take cash out.
criteria.declined_transfer: An outgoing transfer was declined/rejected by the bank.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A direct debit on the account they do not recognise; charged by mistake on the debit statement.
examples: I think I was charged by mistake on my debit statement.

criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards specifically (how many uses, how many disposable cards).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change name, address, email, phone or other personal details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees for exchanging currencies; is there a charge for currency exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used / where to see current rates (not for cash withdrawals).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange/convert money between currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.

extra_charge_on_statement.meaning: An unexplained extra charge on the statement they do not understand, especially a small amount like £1/$1 (even if it is pending or looks like a purchase).
examples: My statement shows a 1£ purchase pending. I do not remember making this purchase.

criteria.failed_transfer: An outgoing transfer failed/did not go through (not declined for beneficiary).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding/spending; can I hold X currency.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get/create a disposable (single-use) virtual card.

get_physical_card.meaning: Where to find, get or set the PIN for the (physical) card.
examples: How do I find the PIN?
How do I set my physical card PIN?

getting_spare_card.meaning: Getting an additional/extra/spare card, e.g. for a family member; how many cards can I have in total.
examples: How do I go about ordering another card?
What's the limit on total number of cards I can have?

criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card; cost of virtual card.

lost_or_stolen_card.meaning: The card was lost or stolen; wants to freeze/block the card immediately; help retrieving a missing card.
examples: Can you provide information for freezing my card immediately?
Can you help me retrieve my card?

criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Their phone was lost or stolen; access to the app without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a physical card; ordering a new card; cost of ordering a card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; reset passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A payment or purchase is pending or has not gone through yet; what a pending payment means.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.

pending_top_up.meaning: A top-up is still pending / not completed yet.
examples: Where are my funds? I topped off my car but it didn't seem to complete.
I'm not certain my top-up went through yet.

pending_transfer.meaning: A transfer they made is shown as pending / still in progress / taking long to complete (incl. international); how long must I wait for it.
examples: How long do you expect me to wait for the transfer? It finally worked out, but has been pending for a long time and it's quite urgent.
When will the transaction post to my account?
It seems like I have been waiting forever for this international transfer. Why is it taking so long? All of the account information is correct, so how long will this take?

criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblock PIN.

receiving_money.meaning: How to receive money/salary into the account; do I need to add my salary; can someone send me money.
examples: Do I need to add my salary?

criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request a refund for a purchase; how to get a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled back to the account.

supported_cards_and_currencies.meaning: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard/American Express etc.) and currencies can be used to add money; why a particular card brand does not work for adding money.
examples: Why doesn't it work when I use American Express to try to add money to my account?

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.meaning: Questions that mention SWIFT or SEPA transfers (do you receive them, can I do one, is there a fee); fee for bank transfers into the account.
examples: I want to do a swift transfer
Is there a charge for SEPA transfers?
Do you receive SWIFT transfers?

criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee charged for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Can I top up with cash or a cheque.

top_up_failed.meaning: A top-up failed / did not work / was declined; not sure whether the top-up went through; cannot access money because something is wrong with the top-up.
examples: I'm not sure if my pop-up went through.
I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly.

criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amount; maximum top-up.

top_up_reverted.meaning: A top-up was reverted/cancelled/returned, or money taken for a top-up disappeared / top-up went through then vanished.
examples: I already completed my 3D secure authentication when I tried the crypto top up but it's still not working. I also don't understand what happened to the money in my account

criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card; card top-up questions (not fees, not failed).

transfer_fee_charged.meaning: Charged a fee for making a transfer, including higher or increased fees for using the account/banking abroad.
examples: Could you inform me as to why I have been charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad.
I thought transfers could be made for free. I just made a purchase online from abroad and now see some strange fee.
I have used this account overseas recently. Has there been an increase in fees that I am unaware of?

criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer/top up money into my account by bank transfer; transferring in not working.

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.meaning: Money I transferred has not arrived / is not there yet at the recipient or destination account, e.g. sent days ago and still not there.
examples: I have done a transfer within the country the day before yesterday, but it's still not there yet. The account number is the right one.
I transferred some money but it is not here yet

criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive (e.g. from a UK account, international); normal time frame for a transfer.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but it fails / cannot complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed.

verify_source_of_funds.meaning: Verifying/proving the source of funds; finding out where funds come from or flow; seeing the source of available money.
examples: How can I find out where the funds are flow?
Can I see my available money?

verify_top_up.meaning: Verification code for a top-up card or card transfer (can't find/see the code); verifying a card used to top up.
examples: I don't see the verification code for my card transfer.

virtual_card_not_working.meaning: A virtual card does not work / is declined.
examples: What is the reason I got rejected for using my disposable virtual card to pay a subscription to the gym?

visa_or_mastercard.meaning: Is the card Visa or Mastercard; which network; wanting to get a Visa or Mastercard card specifically.
examples: Please help me get a Visa card.

criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.meaning: Exchange rate or currency for cash withdrawals / foreign ATMs: which or wrong rate applied when getting cash, withdrawing in home currency abroad.
examples: Can I make a withdraw in my home currency at an ATM? I'm on vacation. Is it possible to withdraw here without any additional costs or fees?
what is the exchange rate for foreign ATMs
